name: The Blush Halo | Round Diamond & Pink Sapphire Ring
subtitle: 14K White Gold · Natural or Lab-Grown Diamond
summary: A round brilliant diamond framed by a fine pink sapphire halo on a diamond-accented beaded band in polished 14K white gold.
description:
A timeless classic, with a delicate touch of pink.

Some details deserve a second look.

The Blush Halo Ring features a beautiful round brilliant diamond surrounded by a whisper-thin halo of pink sapphires. The soft contrast adds just enough colour to make this timeless design feel beautifully distinctive.

Set in polished 14K white gold, the ring features an exceptionally delicate, diamond-accented beaded band. Its fine detailing adds subtle sparkle while allowing the centre diamond to remain the star.

Romantic without being overly traditional, the Blush Halo is for someone who loves a classic round diamond but appreciates an unexpected detail.

Available with your choice of natural or lab-grown centre diamond.

Diamond colour and clarity: Available upon request.

Contact Toronto Jewels Curation to discuss your preferred diamond and ring size.
